scope: Fix for wrong ground-radius tree targeting and missing native ShaderWorld render-tree publication. Source/geometry, rendered normal-PIE backend pixel acceptance, and cooked CPU/physics/persistence regressions are independent evidence.

causes.old_selection: C projected through canopy to ground and selected an uncleared trunk in an 800 cm XY radius; a different tree could be removed.
causes.new_selection: Fresh exact mouse ray; nearest tagged visual tree transformed local mesh bounds before terrain or solid occluders. No radius fallback. The Roden tool previews a yellow box; the bounds approximate the crown silhouette.

causes.old_render_commit: CPU instance-transform changes and MarkRenderStateDirty did not reliably publish the ExternalLegacyData instance buffer.
causes.new_render_commit: Changed visual pools are queued and refreshed through native SWUpdateTree when mesh data is ready; native concurrent-build handling restarts as needed. No plugin patch, no forbidden UE BuildTreeIfOutdated call.

builds.package_method: Re-stage and archive with SkipCook after code-only changes; existing cooked assets reused.

native_automation.scope: NullRHI C++ geometry/state tests, including CursorRayBounds; no normal mouse or GPU pixel evidence.
known_warnings: Cleanup of intentionally created testworld citizen without a world context.
Intentionally rejected historical applied paint record.

normal_pie_pixels.method: Native editor console/Python calls the reflected ray picker and clearing/persistence backend in the real normal PIE world. Separate test slots preserve the user city. Fixed top-down camera, same exact target/control across before/after/load frames.
normal_pie_pixels.reason: The native input harness did not establish actual game viewport focus; production focus/UI guards were retained.
normal_pie_pixels.inspect_resource_scope: Only ledger entries are inspected. Default zero counts for an uncleared ID do not establish absence; control was separately queried by its original anchor and compared by value.
normal_pie_pixels.visual_review: Agent inspected all three unchanged original full frames; target crown at orange center marker disappears, blue control neighbor remains. No automated pixel equality test; water, wind, foliage and temporal effects vary.

cooked_regression.scope: Terrain/physics, CPU visual-transform arrays, active collision instances, real vegetation regeneration, 30-second observation and repeated save/load. These checks do not independently inspect tree GPU pixels.

limits: Subsequent user feedback confirms trying the corrected clearing; the native screenshot probe itself did not exercise C or yellow preview. Preview-specific details and focus/occlusion edge cases remain unverified.
Tree mesh bounds approximate leaves and may contain empty crown space; no exact per-leaf silhouette picking.
RenderRefreshRequests counts requests, not a GPU fence or guaranteed latency.
The preview additionally scans tree pools at up to 5 Hz. Large-world or large-clearing performance is unmeasured; existing periodic rescan optimization remains planned.
No packaged per-tree pixel acceptance, Shipping test, general collision-driving proof, wood yield, machinery, or production clearing economy.

user_confirmation.source: Direct user feedback in the active project conversation after the corrected clearing was provided.
user_confirmation.scope: The user confirms having tried the corrected clearing. This is subsequent human feedback, separate from the earlier native backend screenshot probe.
user_confirmation.limitations: No detailed input trace, preview-specific statement, exhaustive focus/occlusion pass, performance measurement, or packaged pixel acceptance can be inferred from this short confirmation.
